title: FRED OECD Composite Leading Indicators
description: Business-cycle turning-point signal via OECD Composite Leading Indicators (amplitude-adjusted, normalized, trend-restored) mirrored through FRED for G7 + major emerging markets (USA/Japan/Germany/UK/France/Italy/Canada/Brazil/China/India/Korea/Mexico + OECD aggregate). CLI normalised to 100: >100 = above trend, <100 = below trend. Script computes 3-month and 12-month momentum then classifies regime - EXPANSION_ACCELERATING, EXPANSION_PEAKING, CONTRACTION_DEEPENING, CONTRACTION_BOTTOMING, STEADY - plus a rotation thesis (cyclicals XLI/XLF when accelerating; defensives XLU/XLP/XLV + long duration when contracting; small caps/financials on a recovery bottom). Uses existing FRED_API_KEY.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'country_code', 'country_name', 'series_id', 'latest_value',
    'latest_date', 'value_3m_ago', 'value_12m_ago',
    'cli_momentum_3m', 'cli_momentum_12m', 'regime_flag',
    'business_cycle_phase', 'rotation_thesis', '_epoch',
]

SERIES = [
    {'id': 'USALOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'USA', 'name': 'United States'},
    {'id': 'JPNLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'JPN', 'name': 'Japan'},
    {'id': 'DEULOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'DEU', 'name': 'Germany'},
    {'id': 'GBRLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'GBR', 'name': 'United Kingdom'},
    {'id': 'FRALOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'FRA', 'name': 'France'},
    {'id': 'ITALOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'ITA', 'name': 'Italy'},
    {'id': 'CANLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'CAN', 'name': 'Canada'},
    {'id': 'BRALOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'BRA', 'name': 'Brazil'},
    {'id': 'CHNLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'CHN', 'name': 'China'},
    {'id': 'INDLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'IND', 'name': 'India'},
    {'id': 'KORLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'KOR', 'name': 'South Korea'},
    {'id': 'MEXLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'MEX', 'name': 'Mexico'},
    {'id': 'OECDLOLITONOSTSAM', 'iso3': 'OECD', 'name': 'OECD Aggregate'},
]

def classify_regime(cli, m3):
    if cli is None:
        return {'regime': 'UNKNOWN', 'phase': 'Unknown', 'thesis': 'Insufficient data - monitor'}
    m3_val = m3 if m3 is not None else 0.0
    if cli >= 100.5 and m3_val > 0.0:
        return {'regime': 'EXPANSION_ACCELERATING', 'phase': 'Expansion', 'thesis': 'Overweight cyclicals (XLI, XLF, industrials, small-caps); underweight defensives'}
    if cli >= 100.0 and m3_val < -0.1:
        return {'regime': 'EXPANSION_PEAKING', 'phase': 'Late Cycle', 'thesis': 'Rotate to quality; trim cyclicals; gold/bonds begin to bid (GLD, TLT)'}
    if cli < 100.0 and m3_val < -0.2:
        return {'regime': 'CONTRACTION_DEEPENING', 'phase': 'Slowdown / Recession', 'thesis': 'Overweight defensives (XLU, XLP, XLV); long duration (TLT, AGG)'}
    if cli < 100.0 and m3_val > 0.1:
        return {'regime': 'CONTRACTION_BOTTOMING', 'phase': 'Recovery', 'thesis': 'Rotate early cyclicals (small-caps, financials, EM); trim defensives'}
    return {'regime': 'STEADY', 'phase': 'Mid Cycle', 'thesis': 'Balanced - monitor for turning points; maintain barbell'}

rows = []
for si in range(len(SERIES)):
    ent = SERIES[si]
    ser_id = ent['id']
    iso3 = ent['iso3']
    name = ent['name']
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE,
            params={
                'series_id': ser_id,
                'api_key': API_KEY,
                'file_type': 'json',
                'sort_order': 'desc',
                'limit': 24,
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json() or {}
        obs = payload.get('observations', []) or []
    except Exception:
        continue
    values = []
    for oi in range(len(obs)):
        o = obs[oi]
        if not isinstance(o, dict):
            continue
        v = o.get('value', '.')
        if v == '.' or v is None:
            continue
        try:
            fv = float(v)
        except Exception:
            continue
        values.append({'date': str(o.get('date', '') or ''), 'value': fv})
    if not values:
        continue
    latest = values[0]['value']
    latest_date = values[0]['date']
    idx_3m = 2
    if idx_3m >= len(values):
        idx_3m = len(values) - 1
    idx_12m = 11
    if idx_12m >= len(values):
        idx_12m = len(values) - 1
    v3m = values[idx_3m]['value']
    v12m = values[idx_12m]['value']
    m3 = round(latest - v3m, 3)
    m12 = round(latest - v12m, 3)
    cycle = classify_regime(latest, m3)
    rows.append({
        'country_code': iso3,
        'country_name': name,
        'series_id': ser_id,
        'latest_value': round(latest, 3),
        'latest_date': latest_date,
        'value_3m_ago': round(v3m, 3),
        'value_12m_ago': round(v12m, 3),
        'cli_momentum_3m': m3,
        'cli_momentum_12m': m12,
        'regime_flag': cycle['regime'],
        'business_cycle_phase': cycle['phase'],
        'rotation_thesis': cycle['thesis'],
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values(['cli_momentum_3m'], ascending=[False]).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
